head: codex/5733-demo-matrix-proof-coverage
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15] Reconcile demo matrix proof coverage
body:
Closes #5733

Reconciles the v0.91.8 demo matrix and feature-proof coverage with current owner, evidence, and non-claim truth after WP-15 convergence and podcast launch-route work. The docs now distinguish proven, retained-proof, planning, open-gate, deferred, and non-claim surfaces instead of presenting every row as equivalent proof.

Key boundaries preserved:
- #5354 is consumed as bounded integrated convergence proof; this PR does not rerun or replace its proof.
- Podcast #5717/#5720 source routes, RSS, and smoke audio are represented without claiming public hosting, directory approval, final audio, video, mailbox verification, or weekly cadence durability.
- v0.92 handoff and release-tail rows remain open gates where their owner issues are still open.
